name: auxtools
description: Debug BYOND worlds with breakpoints, stepping, variable inspection and hot reload.

auxtools.byondPath.markdownDescription: BYOND installation directory, containing `bin`. Leave empty for automatic discovery.

auxtools.launcherPath.markdownDescription: Optional launcher override. Leave empty to use the bundled `auxtools` launcher.

auxtools.debugLibrary.markdownDescription: Optional `debug_server.dll` or `libdebug_server.so` override. Leave empty to use the library bundled with the extension.

auxtools.addToTerminalPath.markdownDescription: Add the launcher directory to VS Code terminals' `PATH` so `auxtools` commands are available.

auxtools.autoJoin.markdownDescription: Join launched worlds with DreamSeeker automatically (Windows). Clients reconnect after reboot.

auxtools.closeDreamSeeker.markdownDescription: Close clients opened by the extension when their world process exits.

reconnect.description: Offer to reconnect players after a skin or client script reload.

join.description: Offer to join when not joined automatically; offer the address if DreamSeeker is unavailable.

rebuild.description: Warn when hot reload cannot apply a change.

dme.description: Project .dme path. Defaults to the file beside the .dmb; its directory is the source root.

enumDescriptions: Console DreamDaemon (dd.exe on Windows), with output in the Debug Console
Windowed DreamDaemon (Windows), with output in its own window
Host and join the world in DreamSeeker (Windows)
server.description: BYOND host program. Default: DreamDaemon (dd.exe on Windows).

defines.description: Build defines as NAME, NAME=VALUE or DreamMaker -D arguments. Must match the build. If omitted, uses flags from the SS13 Build Flags extension if present. Use [] to disable automatic flags.

hotReload.description: Reload supported source changes on save, including when running without debugging.

sleepingThreads.description: Maximum sleeping procs listed in the Call Stack view while paused.

byondPath.description: BYOND installation path. Overrides auxtools.byondPath and automatic discovery.

port.description: Listening port. If omitted, DreamDaemon chooses a free port when the process starts.

args.description: Arguments after the .dmb, replacing the defaults: -trusted, plus -close for dreamdaemon-gui on Windows.

debugLibrary.description: Override auxtools.debugLibrary for this launch. If neither is set, use the library bundled with the extension.

processId.description: World process ID. If omitted, select a running debugger-enabled world.

dme.description: Project .dme path, if different from the file beside the running .dmb.

defines.description: Build defines as NAME, NAME=VALUE or DreamMaker -D arguments. Must match the build. If omitted, uses flags from the SS13 Build Flags extension if present. Use [] to disable automatic flags.

hotReload.description: Reload source changes on save. Disabled by default for attach sessions to avoid competing reloads.

sleepingThreads.description: Maximum sleeping procs listed in the Call Stack view while paused.
